header.description: What: on basic-desert a BLUE and a RED stochastic platoon (30 men each, from the TKB composite) face each other 200 m apart, both defending. They fire on each other (agg-backend's phase A), so their slot tables CHANGE during the run (hits, stress, ammunition). Judge: the run is recorded; the review harness (--verify-review-at) seeks through it and every component - above all UnitSlotTable and UnitHoldings - equals live at every keyframe, and live comes back exact. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-recorded and: dotnet <runner> --mode editor --headless --verify agg-recorded --verify-review-at 30 (Placed on basic-desert's FLAT ground north of the 9 m mound at y 200-220 - agg-backend R-4286: with F-19 a stochastic unit stands ON the terrain, and on the mound Blue was hull-down behind its crest: Red never saw it.)
